agent: agent wave, reader A: the AI's hourly pass and the agents' life
question: ProcessAI whole, every CEU3AI helper it calls named by purpose; the unit agents' creation, binding and removal; CEU3AI +0x2C/+0x94/+0xA5/+0xA6/+0x128; CAIUnit::Tick's gates and flag bytes +0x80-+0x88

addresses.name: ProcessAI
addresses.comment: **One country's whole AI pass**, read whole on the listing (rva 0x4894E0 to the `ret 4` at 0x489BB5; two earlier `ret 4` exits at 0x489618 and 0x48986A with the body continuing past them - trap 3). In order: (1) nothing while `ai +0x128` (ai_paused, the console's AI pause) or the country's theatres_dirty (CCountry +0x580) is set; (2) the played country (`ai->id == gamestate->player`) has runs_units (+0x2C) cleared; (3) CEU3AI_RefreshUnitDestinations (0x49A800), AI_ManageUndergrounds (0x489E10); (4) a country owning no province and not in exile: CEU3AI_SendLandlessUnitsOnExpedition (0x499A10) and return; (5) firstPass = unit_pass_done (+0xA5) clear - but in a game loaded from a save (gamestate +0xD9C) firstPass is false and theatres_changed (+0xA6) is cleared; (6) every enabled minister on +0x74 is ticked (slot 9) and the foreign minister answers its offers (0x49E010); (7) the played country with automation[6] == 1: DeployFinishedUnits (0x48B300), every hour; (8) the played country of a loaded game with runs_units clear and no unit agent yet: CreateAgentsForPlannedUnits (0x48BEF0); (9) CEU3AI_DisbandTheatrelessHQs (0x489BD0) - a true answer ends the pass; (10) while theatres_changed is set, the strategy's theatres (CCountry +0x570, which is CAIStrategy +0xE4) are walked: the first whose `unit` does not resolve sends the pass on to (11); when every one resolves, AnnounceLoadedUnitsToScreen(ai, isPlayer), theatres_changed cleared and **return**, so that hour ticks no agent; (11) every unit agent (+0x40) and every invasion agent (+0x50) is ticked through slot 9. Then with hour = (tick - 43800000) % 24 and the country id: (12) at hour 1 of the 1st of a month the failed-invasion areas (+0x94) are freed; at hour id%24 CEU3AI_AssignSeaTargetsToAgents (0x48C140); always CEU3AI_PruneInvasions (0x491BE0) into a local list; (13) a country whose runs_units is clear (the played one): on even hours, for each unit agent CEU3AI_RankInvasionAreas (0x495530) and CEU3AI::PlanAmphibiousInvasion (0x492190) with that agent - and nothing more; (14) every other country: CEU3AI_RecallStrandedLandUnits (0x498870) on the first pass or at hour (id+16)%24; CEU3AI::CreateAgentsForTheatres (0x48AA80); CEU3AI_BindAgentsAndAttachOrphans (0x48DCF0, whose answer is always false); at hour id%24 CEU3AI_ChoosePride (0x499C80), CEU3AI_BalanceDivisionsBetweenTheatres (0x48E490) where unit_pass_done is set, CEU3AI::RebuildPriorityProvinces (0x4976E0), RankInvasionAreas(ai, null), CEU3AI_RebuildWeakEnemyPorts (0x4972E0), CEU3AI::GenerateUnitObjectives (0x4980E0), PlanAmphibiousInvasion(ai, list, null); else at hour (id+8)%24 CEU3AI_GatherTransportsForTheatres (0x490DB0), DeployFinishedUnits, AI_ReassignLeaders (0x498EF0); else at hour (id+16)%24 every unit agent's per-type tally (CAIUnit +0x23C) zeroed, CEU3AI_DistributeFleetsToTheatres (0x48FBB0), CEU3AI_DistributeAirToTheatres (0x48F2B0), and CEU3AI_PromoteLeadersForCommands (0x499280); then CEU3AI::UpdateUnitStances(ai, hour == (id+16)%24) and unit_pass_done = 1. Callers: RunAIPass's tbb parallel_for, once a game hour from the frame after the hour turns; CInGameIdler::Enter for a game loaded from a save; a once-per-process multiplayer kick; idler slot 67 (FINDINGS-ai.md). **A single-player new game runs none of it during its two days and first hour.** See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-agents.md, section A.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled 0x8894E0-0x889BB5 end to end: the 0x128 and +0x580 bails at 0x889506/0x88951C, the +0x2C clear at 0x8895BA, the landless exit at 0x8895E4-0x889618, the +0xA5/+0xD9C block at 0x88961B-0x8896C3, the readiness walk returning at 0x88986A, the four `% 24` computations at 0x88992C-0x889989 (ebx = id%24, [esp+0x28] = (id+8)%24, [esp+0x18] = (id+16)%24, [esp+0x14] = hour), and the if/else-if chain at 0x889A70/0x889ABF/0x889AE0. Wrong if the `jne 0x889a47` at 0x8899ED did not send every country with runs_units set to the AI branch, or if 0x88DCF0 could return non-zero (its one exit at 0x88E480 is `xor al, al`).
addresses.revises: The comment covered only the head (to the foreign minister); now the whole pass in order, with every helper, the hour of each, the readiness gate's return and the callers.

addresses.name: ProcessAI_TheatreReadinessGate
addresses.comment: `cmp byte [edi+0xa6], al` with al == 0 (CEU3AI_DisbandTheatrelessHQs's false answer) - the top of a block in ProcessAI (0x4897E8-0x48986A) that runs only while CEU3AI +0xA6 (theatres_changed) is set. It walks the country's theatres at CCountry +0x570, which is the embedded strategy's area_theatre list (CAIStrategy +0xE4), resolving each theatre's `unit` id pair (CTheatre +0x74/+0x78) through 0xA9D390, and goes on to the agent loops (0x48986D) at the first that does not resolve, leaving the flag set for the next hour. When every theatre has a live HQ - or the country has none - it calls AnnounceLoadedUnitsToScreen(ai, ai->id == gamestate->+0xC34) at 0x48984D, clears +0xA6 at 0x489852 and **returns** (`ret 4` at 0x48986A), so that hour ticks no agent and runs none of the rest of the pass. The constructor seeds +0xA6 to 1, so every country's first AI pass ends here once its HQs exist. Worker thread - AnnounceLoadedUnitsToScreen reaches CCurrentGameState::in_game_screen off the tick thread.
addresses.evidence: Disassembly 0x8897E8-0x88986A: the walk exits to 0x88986D on a null or -8 resolve, and the all-resolved path falls through 0x88982D-0x889852 into the epilogue and `ret 4` at 0x88986A. The +0xA6 seed is `mov dword [edi+0xa4], 0x10000` at 0x888130 in the CEU3AI constructor. Wrong if 0x88986A were not reached from 0x889852 by fall-through.
addresses.revises: Said the block ends by clearing +0xA6; it then returns from ProcessAI, skipping the agents and the AI branch for that hour. Also names +0x570 as the strategy's list and gives the constructor's seed.

addresses.name: CEU3AI_DisbandTheatrelessHQs
addresses.comment: For each unit of the country (CCountry +0xBAC) of level 0 that is no theatre's headquarters (CUnit_FindTheatre null): an agent of its own is removed (CEU3AI_RemoveAgent, 0x499F70), and the answer becomes true where that unit had children; and for a country no person plays, or before in_game, a CDisbandCommand is posted for it. `ret 4`. **Two callers**: CAIStrategy::MaintainTheatres at 0x4ACCE0, in the country's hour, and ProcessAI at 0x4897DB **every hour**, where a true answer ends that country's pass. The name is ours. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-theatres.md, section J, and FINDINGS-agents.md, section A.
addresses.evidence: findRefs --callers 0x889BD0 gives exactly 0x8897DB and 0x8ACCE0; disassembly 0x889BD0-0x889DD8: oob_level test at 0x889C2E, 0x5D2A00 with the unit in EAX, the +0x198 test and call 0x899F70 with the agent in EDI, the +0x1EC children test setting [ebp-0xd], the played/in_game test at 0x889CF0-0x889CFB. Wrong if 0x8897E2's `jne 0x889ba4` did not end the pass.
addresses.revises: Comment said it is called by MaintainTheatres only; ProcessAI calls it every hour too, and its answer ends the pass.

addresses.name: CEU3AI::CreateAgentsForTheatres
addresses.comment: One stack argument. For each theatre of the country's strategy (CCountry +0x570, which is CAIStrategy +0xE4, the saved area_theatre list - not a separate order-of-battle list), it looks along the CEU3AI's unit agents (+0x40) for one whose **root** agent (climbing +0x40) answers slot 65 true and whose area id (+0x68/+0x6C) resolves to this theatre. None: it allocates 0x374 bytes, constructs a CAIUnit, AddRefs it (slot 7), appends it to +0x40/+0x44/+0x48, copies the theatre's id pair (+0x8/+0xC) into +0x68/+0x6C, enables it (slot 52) and, **where the theatre's `unit` (+0x74/+0x78) resolves, binds it to that headquarters at once with slot 63 (SetUnit)**. Called once, from ProcessAI at 0x489A61, every hour for a country whose units the AI runs - a TBB worker. It creates nothing for a theatre EnsureAgentForArea already gave an agent; it is what gives an agent to a theatre that arrives without one (a theatre made by CCreateHigherCommand, or one whose agent was removed).
addresses.evidence: Decompiled and checked on the listing at 0x88AC4D (id pair copy), the Enable call through [vftable+0xD0], the resolve through 0xA9D390 and the slot 63 call at 0x88AC85 (slotcalls 63 lists 0x88AA80 at 0x88AC85). CCountry +0x570 = +0x48C (CCountry::GetStrategy, `lea eax,[ecx+0x48C]`) + 0xE4 (CAIStrategy's area_theatre list, filled by its LoadKey token 0x6EF). Wrong if the slot 63 call were not on the newly made agent.
addresses.revises: The list it walks is the strategy's area_theatre list, not a separate order-of-battle list; and it binds the new agent to the theatre's HQ through SetUnit, which the comment left out.

addresses.name: CEU3AI::EnsureAgentForArea
addresses.comment: `ret 0xC`, read whole. The theatre layer's hook into the agents, on the **tick** thread; `flag` is 0 for a theatre that lives on and 1 for one that is going. For each unit agent (+0x40) in order: (a) with flag clear, an agent whose unit (slot 74) has this theatre as its own (CUnit_FindTheatre) but whose area id is another (CObjectId_Differs) is re-pointed at it; (b) an agent whose area (GetArea) is this theatre, that has no unit or a level-0 one, and whose area id is set, is the one covering it: with flag clear it gets area_dirty (+0x87) = 1 and the function returns; with flag set it gets slot 54 (switches its unit's plan off) and is removed (CEU3AI_RemoveAgent) and the function returns; (c) otherwise, **where runs_units (+0x2C) is clear, that agent's slot 76 (BuildPlan) is called**. No agent covering it, and runs_units set: a new CAIUnit with the theatre's id pair, area_dirty = 1, AddRef, Enable, appended to +0x40 - **with no unit**; the unit is bound later by CEU3AI_BindAgentsAndAttachOrphans. Callers: CAIStrategy::BuildTheatres at 0x4ABAEF (each old theatre deleted, flag 1) and 0x4ABC38 (each theatre made or kept, flag 0), CAIStrategy::RefreshTheatreProvinces at 0x4ABE8F (a theatre left with no provinces, flag 1) and 0x4ABFAE (the others, flag 0).
addresses.evidence: Disassembly 0x88A880-0x88AA73: the flag test at 0x88A8B0, the re-point at 0x88A8FF-0x88A908, the cover test 0x88A90B-0x88A93E, the +0x87 write at 0x88A9F6 and return, the slot 54 ([+0xD8]) + 0x899F70 arm at 0x88AA10, the runs_units-clear slot 76 ([+0x130]) call at 0x88A94D, and the creation arm 0x88A961-0x88AA60 with `mov byte [esi+0x87],1` at 0x88A9B5. The four call sites push 1, 0, 1, 0 (0x8ABAEB, 0x8ABC26, 0x8ABE8B, 0x8ABF9C). Wrong if `[ebp+0x10]` were not the third stack argument.
addresses.revises: Was likely and vague on the flag; now read whole: the flag is 'the theatre is going', an existing agent is marked dirty or removed, a clear runs_units calls slot 76 on the other agents, and a new agent has no unit.

addresses.name: CAIUnit::Tick
addresses.comment: **Slot 73, the whole of what a unit agent does each hour** (0x4B0730 to the bare `ret` at 0x4B0D17), settled on the listing. hour = (tick - 43800000) % 24, days = (tick - 43800000) / 24, dayOfYear = days - (int)((int)(days / 365.0) * 365.0); staggers A0 = id%24, A3 = (id+3)%24, A6 = (id+6)%24, A9 = (id+9)%24 off CAIAgent +0x38. In order: (1) area_dirty (+0x87), or hour 1 on a dayOfYear divisible by 7: SetArea(this, GetArea()); (2) hour A0 or stance_set (+0x80) clear: UpdatePlanAxis (0x4C3330); (3) a land unit: its plan's objectives copied into CArmy +0x2EC; (4) **slot 82 every hour**, flag = hour A0 on a dayOfYear divisible by 9; (5) hour A3: slot 85; (6) **no unit: return**; (7) hour A9: RebuildFocusOwnerAreas (0x4B0D20); (8) F ('full pass') = hour A6 or full_pass_pending (+0x84); (9) +0x368 = 0x4DCAE0(this); (10) **slot 78 when replan_subordinates (+0x86) or hour A9 or F**; (11) CAIUnit_UpdateThreatenedProvinces (0x4B1820) every hour; (12) F: slot 79 (ManageExpeditions); (13) F, or air_target_lists_built (+0x83) clear: BuildAirTargetProvinceLists; (14) slot 80 runs when hold_provinces_built (+0x82) is clear, or the threatened-provinces list (+0x1E4) is non-empty, or F and (day of month % 7 == 0 or runs_units clear); (15) F: where the unit is level 0 and the area id is set, CAIUnit_ComputePlanForcesAndPower (0x4B60F0) for a played country, else CAIUnit_ComputePlanForces (0x4B5210); (16) F, or (the country at war, in an undeclared war or with provinces in revolt, and hour % 3 == 0): 0x4CC450, 0x4D7F80, 0x4CC690 where the vector +0x10C is non-empty, 0x4CC020; (17) F: CAIUnit_PullHeadquartersIn; (18) where this is the nearest agent at or above its unit (CUnit +0x198 up +0x1E0): 0x4C4370(this, hour A6), CAIUnit_ManageAirUnits(this, F), CAIUnit_ManageNavalUnits(this, F or replan_naval +0x85); (19) CAIUnit_MoveAgentUnitToCommandProvince every hour; (20) F, or the same war-and-hour%3 test: CAIUnit_ManageLandUnits. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-agents.md, section A.
addresses.evidence: Disassembled 0x8B0730-0x8B0D17 and traced every edge: the staggers at 0x8B07E5-0x8B0861 ([esp+0xc] = A0, [esp+0x1c] = A3, [esp+0x18] = A6, [esp+0x20] = A9, [esp+0x10] = hour); F set at 0x8B09D2-0x8B09EA; slot 78 ([+0x138]) reached at 0x8B0A13 from +0x86 != 0, hour == A9 or F; the slot 80 ([+0x140]) gate at 0x8B0A54-0x8B0A99; the F path from 0x8B0A9B always reaching 0x8B0BC0; the war test at 0x8B0B84-0x8B0BBE (+0xACC, +0xACD, +0xF50, hour % 3). Wrong if `jne 0x8b0a13` at 0x8B0A04 tested something other than +0x86.

addresses.name: CAIUnit::SetUnit
addresses.comment: **Slot 63**, 0x4B9EB0 to the `ret 4` at 0x4BA05C (slot 64 abuts it at 0x4BA060). **Binds an agent to its unit.** False at once if `this[+0x64]` is already set. Otherwise: a *different* agent in `unit[+0x198]` is given slot 64 (ClearUnit) with the unit; `unit[+0x198] = this` where `this[+0x3D]` and `this[+0x3E]` are clear; `this[+0x64] = unit`; the area id (+0x68/+0x6C) is resolved through the id registry and handed to SetArea (0x4BA5A0); a CActivateUnitPlanCommand(unit, 1, unit's plan byte +0x205) is posted - **the unit's battle plan switched on**; slot 78 (ManageSubordinates) and CAIUnit::UpdatePlanPower (0x4B5060) run; true. Reached through slot 63 from CEU3AI::CreateAgentsForTheatres, CEU3AI_BindAgentsAndAttachOrphans, CreateAgentsForPlannedUnits and CreateUnitAgent, and from CCreateHigherCommand::Execute and CCreateNewHQCommand::Execute on a unit's existing agent (CUnit +0x198), where it is a no-op if that agent is bound. (PlanAmphibiousInvasion's slot 63 calls are on a CAIInvasion - its AddUnit.)
addresses.evidence: Disassembly 0x8B9EB0-0x8BA05C: early `xor al,al; ret 4` at 0x8BA049-0x8BA05C; the slot 64 call ([+0x100]) at 0x8B9EF8; the stores at 0x8B9F04/0x8B9F0A; SetArea at 0x8B9F41; CActivateUnitPlanCommand (0x5E5350) pushed (cmd, unit, 1, byte [unit+0x205]) at 0x8B9F5C-0x8B9F72 and posted at 0x8BA01E; slot 78 ([+0x138]) at 0x8BA02A, 0x8B5060 at 0x8BA02E, `mov al,1` at 0x8BA033. Wrong if the plan command's second argument were not the activation flag (FINDINGS-aiunit.md's command table has 0x5E5350 as CActivateUnitPlanCommand).
addresses.revises: Returns a bool (false when already bound); after SetArea it posts CActivateUnitPlanCommand(unit, 1, ...) and runs slot 78 and UpdatePlanPower, none of which the comment had.

addresses.name: CAIUnit::ClearUnit
addresses.comment: **Slot 64**, 0x4BA060 to the `ret 4` at 0x4BA291, read whole. Nothing unless `unit` is this agent's (+0x64). Then: the unit's AI scratch is cleared - the floats CUnit +0x2B8 and +0x2BC, the bytes +0x2C8, +0x2C9 and +0x2CA; for a land unit, its CArmy +0x2EC objective scratch is freed and, where CArmy +0x2E8 is non-zero, it is zeroed and a CSetAIParamCommand(unit, 0, 0) posted; a CActivateUnitPlanCommand(unit, 0, 0) is posted - **the battle plan switched off**; `this[+0x64] = 0`. **It does not clear `unit[+0x198]`**: the agent's destructor does that (CAIAgent's, 0x49C7C0, walking the owner's units), and SetUnit overwrites it. Called on the old agent by SetUnit, by ~CAIUnit (0x4AFC68) for its own unit, and from CAIAgent's slot-68 path.
addresses.evidence: Disassembly 0x8BA060-0x8BA291: the +0x64 compare at 0x8BA082, the scratch stores at 0x8BA091-0x8BA0A8, the land test through [vftable+0x3C], the +0x2E8 test and CSetAIParamCommand (0x5E90B0) with two zeros, CActivateUnitPlanCommand (0x5E5350) with (unit, 0, 0), and `mov [esi+0x64], ebx` at 0x8BA27F. No store to +0x198 in the body. Wrong if a callee cleared +0x198 (0x486A70 only frees a list).
addresses.revises: Read line by line: what it clears, the two commands it posts, and that it leaves CUnit +0x198 alone. Raised from likely.

addresses.name: CEU3AI_RefreshUnitDestinations
addresses.comment: First thing ProcessAI does for every country, every hour (0x4895C0). For each unit of the country (CCountry +0xBAC): movement_destination_province_id (CUnit +0x2CC) = the province id in the last node of its path (+0x13C) where the path has any (+0x140 > 0), else 0. Bare `ret`, receiver in ECX. The name is ours.
addresses.evidence: Disassembly 0x89A800-0x89A83D, twenty instructions, read whole. Wrong if +0x13C were not the path's last node (the record names it so, FINDINGS-movement.md).

addresses.name: CEU3AI_SendLandlessUnitsOnExpedition
addresses.comment: ProcessAI's step for a country that owns no province and is not a government in exile (0x489602), every hour, after which the pass ends. Nothing unless the country's faction is a real one (faction slot 7). For each unit below theatre level (oob_level != 0), for each other faction member that is not in exile: a fleet or air unit is sent (CSendExpeditionCommand(unit, member)) only to the **faction leader** (the first member, `---` when none); a land unit to the member that controls the province it stands in, and also to the leader where that province's controller is in another faction (or none). Theatre headquarters stay. `ret 4`. The name is ours.
addresses.evidence: Disassembly 0x899A10-0x899C6F: faction slot 7 at 0x899A4D, the oob_level test at 0x899A81, the member loop (+0x28 first, next at +0xC) skipping our id and +0x95, the leader compare at 0x899B04 and the two branches to the post at 0x899B7D (CSendExpeditionCommand 0x5E95B0 pushed (unit, member tag)). Wrong if the leader were not the first member of Faction +0x28.

addresses.name: CEU3AI_AssignSeaTargetsToAgents
addresses.comment: ProcessAI at hour id%24, every country (0x4899B9). Read for its shape only: it builds the enemy list (countries at war, undeclared-war opponents, the strategy's war targets), clears every unit agent's submarine_want (CAIUnit +0xD8) and target containers (+0x24C, +0x25C, +0x26C, +0x284, the vector +0x18C), and then hands each enemy convoy, each enemy fleet, each enemy province of its capital's area producing oil or holding a building past level 1 (owner == controller), recent naval battles of our side (0x487FC0) and allied fleets to the unit agent whose theatre's ports (+0x94) are nearest by sea (CMapProvince::NavalDistanceTo, 2000 and 3000 cut-offs), a convoy adding its desired transports to that agent's submarine_want, which is divided by 20 at the end. The third piece's (naval targeting). The name is ours.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled; the +0xD8 clear at 0x88C299 and divide at 0x88D51A-0x88D52A, the container clears and the naval-distance calls checked on the listing. The scoring was not read. Wrong if +0xD8 here were not CAIUnit +0xD8 - the loop walks ai->+0x40, the unit-agent list.

addresses.name: CEU3AI_PruneInvasions
addresses.comment: ProcessAI every hour (0x4899E1), before the branch: walks the invasion agents (+0x50); one that is finished (+0x3E) is dropped; for an AI-run country one whose objective's area (CAIInvasion +0x84 -> +0x2B4) is still among the ranked invasion areas (+0xC8, or a neighbour of one) is kept and its area appended to `areasOut`; for the played country one is kept while some unit agent's plan objective lies in that area. A dropped invasion's fleets are given order none and the land units aboard unloaded (CUnloadArmyCommand), and the agent removed (0x892133). `areasOut` then tells PlanAmphibiousInvasion which areas are already being invaded. The third piece's (invasions). Read for its shape. The name is ours.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled and the call sites checked: ret 8 at 0x892182, CUnloadArmyCommand built inline, IssueUnitOrder(0x18D), 0x899F70 at 0x892133. Wrong if +0x3E were not CAIInvasion's finished byte (FINDINGS-aitheatre.md section 6).

addresses.name: CEU3AI_RankInvasionAreas
addresses.comment: Rebuilds the CEU3AI's ranked list of areas to invade at +0xC8 (sorted insert 0x49C240), skipping areas in the failed-invasion list (+0x94), and only when the country's transport tonnage reaches four times a reference unit's weight (SumTransportWeight, 0x5D66D0); a random term from MT19937Next, the acting capital's distance, a doubling for the target's capital area; entries under a tenth of the first are dropped. ProcessAI: with null at hour id%24 for an AI-run country, with each unit agent on even hours for the played one. The third piece's (invasions). Read for its shape only. The name is ours.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled: the +0xC8 free at the head, the +0x94 membership test at 0x89604F-0x896062, three 0x49C240 inserts, the tenth-of-the-first prune at the end; ret 8 at 0x8971B2. Wrong if +0xC8 were read by something other than invasion code - its consumers are 0x491BE0 and 0x492190.

addresses.name: CEU3AI_RecallStrandedLandUnits
addresses.comment: ProcessAI on an AI-run country's first pass and at hour (id+16)%24 (0x489A57). For each land unit standing in a province another country controls, where the area is no front (AreaMayWidenFrontSearch false), the unit is not fighting, aboard or retreating, the province is not an enemy's and its destination is neither an enemy's nor ours nor a front: the nearest province it can reach in the country's own areas (x0.25 in the acting capital's area), else the nearest in a neighbouring area it may operate in (10000 off where we control it), else for a level 4+ unit the nearest port of its area, else the acting capital - MoveUnit there; with nowhere, a CDisbandCommand. A trespassing army's AI parameter +0x2E8 is cleared where its host is a friend. The third piece's (movement). Read for its shape. The name is ours.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled; the MoveUnit and CDisbandCommand posts and the constants 0.25 (0x160A258), 10000.0 (0x160A370), 1e6 (0x160A598) read off .rdata. `ret 4` at 0x898EEC, AI_ReassignLeaders beginning at 0x898EF0. Wrong if the gates read differently on the listing; only their shape is claimed.

addresses.name: CEU3AI_BindAgentsAndAttachOrphans
addresses.comment: ProcessAI every hour for an AI-run country (0x489A67), right after CreateAgentsForTheatres. Read whole on the listing. (1) **Binding**: each unit agent with no unit whose root's area resolves to a theatre gets that theatre's headquarters (its `unit`) through slot 63 (SetUnit) - this is how the agents EnsureAgentForArea makes in a new game's first hour get their units. (2) Then **nothing more unless every unit agent has stance_set (+0x80)**. (3) For each unit of the country's list (+0xBAC) in order: one owned by another country is unlinked from the list (or marked, where the list may not unlink); a level-0 unit that is no theatre's HQ loses its agent and, for a country nobody plays, gets a CDisbandCommand; a unit of any other level with no agent and no parent (a top-level orphan) is attached (CAttachUnitCommand) under the headquarters of the theatre stamped on its province (CMapProvince +0x380) where that theatre is ours and its HQ ours and of a lower level, else - that HQ of the same or a higher level - disbanded for a country nobody plays; where no such theatre, under the unit of the unit agent nearest it (CMap::DistanceBetweenProvinces, from 1e7, the first of equals). **Always answers false** (`xor al, al` at its one exit), so ProcessAI's gates on it always pass. The name is ours.
addresses.evidence: Disassembly 0x88DCF0-0x88E48D: the bind loop with slot 63 ([+0xFC]) at 0x88DDC0, the +0x80 walk to 0x88E47A, the foreign-unit unlink at 0x88DE32-0x88DEB9, the level-0 branch with FindTheatreForUnit and 0x899F70, the orphan branch from 0x88E07A (+0x198 and +0x1E0 zero, +0x130 -> +0x380/+0x384, CTheatre +0x7C/+0x80, CTheatre_GetUnit, the oob_level compare at 0x88E125, CAttachUnitCommand 0x5DE890), the nearest-agent search from 0x88E2FA, and the single exit at 0x88E480. Checked against the saves: the four top-level non-theatre units of Germany1936_01_01_00 (USA's Asiatic Fleet and 2nd USN Submarine Fleet, two Japanese air units) are under theatres by _01_04_12. Wrong if an orphan attached by another body were found.

addresses.name: CEU3AI_ChoosePride
addresses.comment: ProcessAI at hour id%24 for an AI-run country. Over the country's naval units' ships: if any is already the pride of the fleet (CSubUnit +0xA5), nothing; otherwise the ship of a type that can be pride (CSubUnitDefinition +0x39) with the greatest hull (+0x178, through float as /1000 x 1000) plus extra_consumption (CSubUnit +0xCC), the first of equals, gets a CMakePrideCommand (0x5DB490). Bare `ret`. The name is ours.
addresses.evidence: Disassembly 0x899C80-0x899E48: the IsNaval test through [vftable+0x40], the +0xA5 test exiting at 0x899CFC, the +0x39 test, the score at 0x899D0B-0x899D45 and the strict `jbe` at 0x899D5B, the 0x64-byte command at 0x899D7B-0x899D91. Wrong if 0x5DB490 were not CMakePrideCommand's constructor (its Execute is 0x5DB530).

addresses.name: CEU3AI_BalanceDivisionsBetweenTheatres
addresses.comment: ProcessAI at hour id%24 for an AI-run country, once unit_pass_done (+0xA5) is set. Every unit agent with a unit and a resolving theatre re-estimates (CAIUnit::UpdatePlanPower); then an agent short of divisions (divisions_needed +0x354 against divisions_counted +0x358) or with frontier_war_candidate (+0x365) takes land units from the agents of theatres connected to its own (0x4B0710), each moved by CDetachUnitCommand then CAttachUnitCommand under the taker's unit, the two agents' counts adjusted. Read for its shape only; belongs with the subordinates (reader C). The name is ours.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled; UpdatePlanPower per agent, the +0x354/+0x358/+0x365 reads and the detach/attach pair checked; bare `ret` at 0x88F2AD with 0x88F2B0 beginning on the next byte. Wrong if the detach/attach pair moved something other than land units - the candidates come from 0x4BF660 over the giving agent.

addresses.name: CEU3AI_GatherTransportsForTheatres
addresses.comment: ProcessAI at hour (id+8)%24 for an AI-run country. For each unit agent with a unit, a non-zero +0x58 and an amphibious_transport_tonnage (+0xD4) above the transport capacity under it (0x4B4F90): while short, the naval unit with transport capability and no agent of its own whose nearest agent is not short is scored 10 - its sea distance (capped) + its capacity, the best detached and attached under this agent's unit, and both agents get replan_subordinates (+0x86). Read for its shape only; reader C (fleets regrouped) and the invasions. The name is ours.
addresses.evidence: Disassembly 0x890DB0-0x890E42 for the gates (+0x58, +0xD4, 0x4BDCC0, 0x4B4F90), decompilation for the rest; the +0x86 writes at 0x89125F/0x89126D. `ret 4` at 0x8912C4. Wrong if +0xD4 were compared with something other than 0x4B4F90's answer.

addresses.name: CEU3AI_DistributeFleetsToTheatres
addresses.comment: ProcessAI at hour (id+16)%24 for an AI-run country, after every agent's per-type tally (+0x23C) is zeroed. Each naval unit with no agent of its own is handed to the unit agent with the largest unmet naval want (an ordered map of what each agent has been given), moved by CDetachUnitCommand and CAttachUnitCommand under that agent's unit, both agents getting replan_subordinates (+0x86). Read for its shape only; reader C (fleets regrouped). The name is ours.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled; the IsNaval filter, the detach/attach pair and the +0x86 writes (0x88F814, 0x88F839, 0x88FB23, 0x88FB3E) checked on the listing; `ret 4` at 0x8906EF. Wrong if the units moved were not fleets.

addresses.name: CEU3AI_DistributeAirToTheatres
addresses.comment: ProcessAI at hour (id+16)%24 for an AI-run country, after CEU3AI_DistributeFleetsToTheatres. Builds the list of type indices tactical_bomber, strategic_bomber, naval_bomber, transport_plane and paratrooper_brigade (CSubUnitDataBase +0x58, +0x64, +0x68, +0x74, +0x48) and moves units carrying them between the unit agents by the agents' per-type tallies (CAIUnit +0x23C), with CDetachUnitCommand and CAttachUnitCommand. Read for its shape only; reader C (air regrouped). The name is ours.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled; the five cached-type reads and the +0x23C reads at 0x88F8A4-0x88F976 checked; `ret 4` at 0x88FBAD with 0x88FBB0 next. Wrong if the list were not of those five keys - CSubUnitDataBase's cached-definition fields are in the record.

addresses.name: CEU3AI_PromoteLeadersForCommands
addresses.comment: ProcessAI at hour (id+16)%24 for an AI-run country. Counts the country's units with no valid leader by oob_level, divisions (level 4) left out; then from level 6 down to 0, at most one per level: the first free active leader (no unit, rank != 0, a naval leader only for level 5, an air leader only for level 6, not promoted this pass) for a level up to 4 is promoted by (4 - rank) - max(level - 1, 0) ranks where that is at least 1 (CPromoteLeaderCommand(leader, 0, n)) - fleets and air units never. Ends by clearing ai +0xA4. The name is ours.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled whole; `ret 4` at 0x8994F2; the +0xA4 clear at 0x8994BF found by the flag scan. Not checked on the listing line by line, hence inferred. Wrong if the leader slot 8 call were not an is-valid test.

addresses.name: CEU3AI_RebuildWeakEnemyPorts
addresses.comment: ProcessAI at hour id%24 for an AI-run country (0x489AA2; Ghidra's RTTI pass labels it a CProvinceFloat constructor, which it is not). Clears the CEU3AI's list at +0xD8 and refills it, in descending score, with CProvinceFloat records {province id, score}: for each enemy (at war, or a war target) in the scenario, its capital where no land brigade stands, and every port of its areas of fewer than six provinces where none stands - score = naval base level x 100 + air base level x 10, + 1000 where the province is its own supply depot, kept above 0. Read by the invasion planner (0x494CC0). The third piece's. The name is ours.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled; constants 100.0 (0x160A358), 10.0 (0x160A340), 1000.0 (0x160A300) and 0.0 (0x15BED10) read off .rdata; bare `ret` at 0x8976D3. Wrong if the inserts were not into ai+0xD8 (local_48 = param+0xD8 at the head).

addresses.name: CEU3AI_RemoveAgent
addresses.comment: **What removes an agent.** `ret 4`, the agent in EDI. Nothing for null. An agent with a parent (+0x40) is handed to the parent's slot 59. Otherwise a CAIUnit (slot 65) found on the CEU3AI's unit-agent list (+0x40), or a CAIInvasion (slot 66) on its invasion list (+0x50), of the same country (+0x38 against ai +0x24), is unlinked and destroyed through slot 0 with 1 - ~CAIUnit clears its unit's plan (ClearUnit) and unsubscribes it, and CAIAgent's destructor zeroes CUnit +0x198 on every unit of the country pointing at it. Callers: CEU3AI_DisbandTheatrelessHQs, EnsureAgentForArea (a theatre going), CEU3AI_BindAgentsAndAttachOrphans, CEU3AI_PruneInvasions, CEU3AI_RemoveAgentsUnderUnit, CUnit_AttachToParent and CUnit_LeaveParent (a unit's own agent), and the objectives panel (0x34F910). The name is ours.
addresses.evidence: Disassembly 0x899F70-0x89A075: the EDI test, the parent's [+0xEC] call, the slot 65/66 tests ([+0x104]/[+0x108]), the list searches, the id compare at 0x899FE2/0x89A061 and the slot 0 call with 1. findRefs --callers gives eight sites (0x5B99CA, 0x5B9B1F, 0x74FAE1, 0x889C57, 0x88AA20, 0x88DF0D, 0x892133, 0x89A166); each loads EDI just before. CAIAgent's destructor at 0x89C7C0 clears +0x198 at 0x89C81D. Wrong if slot 0 were not the scalar deleting destructor (0x4AFBF0 calls ~CAIUnit then free on bit 0).

addresses.name: CEU3AI_RemoveAgentsUnderUnit
addresses.comment: Called by slot 76 (BuildPlan) first thing (0x4DAC30): collects, without repeats, every unit agent whose unit (slot 74) is a strict descendant of `unit` (climbing CUnit +0x1E0), and removes each (CEU3AI_RemoveAgent) - so a planning agent retires the agents beneath it. `ret 8`. The name is ours.
addresses.evidence: Disassembly 0x89A080-0x89A1A2: the slot 74 call, the +0x1E0 climb, the de-duplicated list and the 0x899F70 loop at 0x89A15D-0x89A16D with the agent loaded into EDI. One caller (0x8DAC30). Wrong if the climb started at the unit itself rather than its parent.

addresses.name: CEU3AI_MarkAgentsNearTheatres
addresses.comment: Called once, by CAIStrategy_TellFriendsOfTheatres (0x4AC390) for each friendly country with an AI, with **our** tag and **their** CEU3AI: each of their unit agents whose unit is level 0 gets area_dirty (+0x87) = 1 where any theatre of ours (CCountry +0x570) is connected (0x4B0710: shares an area, or its HQ can reach theirs) to that agent's theatre - so their next tick re-anchors. `ret 4`. The name is ours.
addresses.evidence: Disassembly 0x88C090-0x88C12F: GetCountry on ECX, the walk of [ai+0x40], the slot 74 level test at 0x88C0DA, GetArea, the walk of our +0x570 and the 0x4B0710 call with the theatre in EDI, the +0x87 write at 0x88C118. Wrong if ECX were the friend's tag - 0x8AC3E9 loads it as `lea ecx,[edi+8]`, the strategy's own tag - ours.

addresses.name: CAIUnit_UpdateThreatenedProvinces
addresses.comment: CAIUnit::Tick every hour (0x4B0A20). Keeps the agent's list of provinces threatened from the sea (+0x1DC/+0x1E0/+0x1E4): a province stays while it is in the agent's theatre and some land unit in a neighbouring sea province, owned by a country at war with us (or REB, or an undeclared war covering it), has it as its next step; others are taken off. Then for each fleet in the agent's sighted list (+0x25C) every land unit it carries (+0x2DC) with a path whose end is a province we own adds that province. A non-empty list keeps slot 80 running every hour. Third piece (defence against landings). The name is ours.
addresses.evidence: Decompiled; the +0x1DC unlink and +0x1E4 decrement at 0x4B1AF8-0x4B1B1D and the append at 0x4B1CBB-0x4B1CD9 checked; `ret 4` at 0x4B1D03. Wrong if +0x25C were not a list of enemy fleets.

addresses.name: CAIUnit_AddThreatenedProvince
addresses.comment: Appends a province to the agent's threatened-provinces list (+0x1DC) unless it is there. `ret 4`, agent in ESI. One caller, 0x5C9CB7 (unread). The name is ours.
addresses.evidence: Disassembly 0x8D56A0-0x8D5710: the membership walk and the 0x10-byte node appended at +0x1E0 with +0x1E4 incremented. Wrong if 0x5C9CB7 loaded something other than an agent into ESI.

struct_fields.name: runs_units
struct_fields.comment: **1 for a country whose units the AI runs, 0 for the human's own.** Seeded 1 by the constructor (0x4880BA); cleared by ProcessAI (0x4895BA) for the played country, its only other writer in 0x480000-0x4EA000. **In a single-player new game ProcessAI first runs after the first hour**, so while the theatre layer builds the theatres in that hour the played country's flag is still 1 and EnsureAgentForArea gives its theatres agents too - agents that are never bound, since only the AI branch binds. Readers: ProcessAI (which branch), EnsureAgentForArea (creates only when set; when clear calls slot 76 on the other agents), CAIUnit::Tick's slot 80 gate, CAIUnit::UpdatePlanAxis (returns unless set), slot 82 (posts CSetCommandLevel only when set), CAIUnit::SetArea (skips its objective-owner-area pass when set), ClassifyOpsAreaFrontier, ManageExpeditions and the manage bodies. Slot 73 also splits on gamestate->played_countries_array[countryId], a different test.
struct_fields.evidence: memscan of byte +0x2C over 0x880000-0x8EA000: writes only at 0x8880BA (1) and 0x8895BA (0). In a new game ProcessAI's callers are RunAIPass (CInGameIdler::Update), Enter's loop gated on loaded_from_save (0x661935) and Update's multiplayer kick (idler +0x68 at 0x65603A) - none runs inside Enter's first hour. CEU3AIs exist then: CGameState::StartAI is called from the CInGameIdler constructor (0x64921B). Wrong if a live new game showed no agent for the played country's theatres (FINDINGS-aiconsumer.md's census saw none for Ireland, in a session whose kind is not recorded).
struct_fields.revises: Adds the first-hour consequence and the EnsureAgentForArea and Tick readers; the rest kept.

struct_fields.name: failed_invasion_areas_first
struct_fields.comment: Head of a CList of COwnerArea* (tail +0x98, count +0x9C; nodes {area, prev, next, byte}): the areas where an invasion found nowhere to land. Appended without repeats by 0x494C40 (called from CAIInvasion stage 3, 0x4A09B0, when 0x493E70 answers nothing); skipped by CEU3AI_RankInvasionAreas; freed by ProcessAI at hour 1 of the 1st of every month (0x4899A2).
struct_fields.evidence: 0x894C40-0x894CB0 read whole (membership walk then append at +0x98/+0x9C); ProcessAI's free at 0x8899A2-0x8899A8 after the day-of-month == 1 and hour == 1 tests; the read at 0x89604F in 0x895530. Wrong if 0x894C40's argument were not an area - stage 3 passes `(+0x84)->+0x2B4`.

struct_fields.name: failed_invasion_areas_last
struct_fields.comment: Tail of the failed-invasion areas CList at +0x94.

struct_fields.name: failed_invasion_areas_count
struct_fields.comment: Count of the failed-invasion areas CList at +0x94.

struct_fields.name: unit_pass_done
struct_fields.comment: **The AI branch of ProcessAI has run at least once.** Zero from the constructor (the dword write at 0x488130); set to 1 at the end of every AI-run country's pass (0x489B94). Read twice, both in ProcessAI: at 0x48961B, where clear it makes the pass a first pass (CEU3AI_RecallStrandedLandUnits runs whatever the hour) unless the game was loaded from a save; and at 0x489A82, where set it lets CEU3AI_BalanceDivisionsBetweenTheatres run at hour id%24.
struct_fields.evidence: memscan of byte +0xA5 over 0x880000-0x8EA000: 0x88961B, 0x889A82 and 0x889B94 on a CEU3AI, and 0x899CF2, which is `cmp byte [eax+0xa5],0` on a ship (CSubUnit pride, the regiment from +0x38 in CEU3AI_ChoosePride) - not this field. Wrong if another writer were found outside that range.
struct_fields.revises: Was flag_a5, meaning not established, with 0x899CF2 counted as a reader - that is CSubUnit +0xA5 (pride). Named.

struct_fields.name: theatres_changed
struct_fields.comment: Seeded **1** by the constructor (`+0xA4 = 0x10000` at 0x488130). Set to 1 by the theatre layer for a country nobody plays when BuildTheatres keeps a new theatre (0x4ABAA4) or deletes an old one (0x4ABB77), and when RefreshTheatreProvinces drops one (0x4ABF22). Cleared by ProcessAI on the first pass of a game loaded from a save (0x4896BC), and by its readiness gate once every theatre of the strategy has a resolvable HQ (0x489852) - **after which that hour's pass returns**, ticking no agent. Written on the tick thread and cleared on a worker.
struct_fields.evidence: The constructor's dword write at 0x888130; the three setters each behind a played_countries_array test (0x8ABA91, 0x8ABB63, 0x8ABF10); ProcessAI's clears and the `ret 4` at 0x48986A. Wrong if the played test let the played country's flag be set.
struct_fields.revises: Adds the constructor's seed of 1, the played-country exception, and that the clearing hour ends the pass.

struct_fields.name: ai_paused
struct_fields.comment: **The console's AI pause**: while set ProcessAI does nothing for the country (0x489506). Zeroed by the constructor (0x488224); toggled for one country or all by the console command at 0x443720, which prints 'AI is paused for:', 'AI Paused for all' and 'AI Unpaused for all'.
struct_fields.evidence: memscan of byte +0x128 over all of .text (positive control: the constructor's write at 0x888224 is found): writers 0x888224 and 0x443A17/0x443ADD in the console command (its strings at 0x44380C-0x443AF4), the rest other classes (CAIStrategy's constructor at 0x8A3656, an interface body at 0x775D86). Wrong if 0x443A17's EAX were not CCountry +0x1D8 - it is loaded from it at 0x443A07.

struct_fields.name: stance_set
struct_fields.comment: Set to 1 by CAIUnit::UpdatePlanAxis (0x4C3397) once it has run with a unit for a country the AI runs, and by CAIUnit::SetPlanStance (slot 77, 0x4C3714); seeded 0. So it means **the agent has posted its plan once** rather than that a stance was chosen. Slot 73 runs UpdatePlanAxis every hour until it is set; CEU3AI_BindAgentsAndAttachOrphans does nothing past binding until every agent of the country has it.
struct_fields.evidence: memscan of byte +0x80 over 0x880000-0x8EA000: writes 0x8C3397 and 0x8C3714 on a CAIUnit; reads 0x8B08CD (Tick) and 0x88DDE2 (0x48DCF0). UpdatePlanAxis's guards at 0x8C3353-0x8C338F (unit, level/parent, runs_units). Wrong if UpdatePlanAxis's write were reached without a unit.
struct_fields.revises: UpdatePlanAxis sets it too, which changes what it means; and its second reader, 0x48DCF0, was missing.

struct_fields.name: hold_provinces_built
struct_fields.comment: Set to 1 by slot 80 (RebuildHoldProvinces) at 0x4B3E62 and cleared by CAIUnit::SetArea at 0x4BBA1E; seeded 0. While it is clear - or the threatened-provinces list (+0x1E4) is non-empty - slot 73 runs slot 80 every hour; once set, only on the full pass and then only on a day of the month divisible by 7, or every full pass for a country whose runs_units is clear.
struct_fields.evidence: memscan over 0x880000-0x8EA000, every size: only 0x8B3E62 (write 1), 0x8BBA1E (write 0) and the tick's read at 0x8B0A54; the gate read off 0x8B0A54-0x8B0A99. Wrong if a word or dword store covered it - none was found.

struct_fields.name: full_pass_pending
struct_fields.comment: **Asks for the tick's full pass**: slot 73's full-pass flag is `hour == (id+6)%24 or this`. Seeded 1 (the constructor's `+0x84 = 0x10101`); set by CAIUnit::SetArea (0x4BBA17) and by 0x4D7F80 (0x4D8505); cleared by 0x4CC450 (0x4CC646), the first body of the tick's land block, which the full pass always reaches. So an agent's first hour with a unit, and the hour after any SetArea with one, is a full pass.
struct_fields.evidence: memscan over 0x880000-0x8EA000: writes 0x8BBA17, 0x8D8505 (1) and 0x8CC646 (0, `mov [esi+0x84], bl` with esi = param_1 of 0x8CC450 - the decompiler's param_1 + 0x21 dwords), the read at 0x8B09DC. Wrong if 0x8CC450's receiver were not the agent - the tick calls it with ECX = this at 0x8B0BC0.

struct_fields.name: replan_naval
struct_fields.comment: Slot 73 passes `force` to CAIUnit_ManageNavalUnits when this or the full pass is set (0x4B0C9F), and that body clears it when forced (0x4D08E8). Seeded 1. Set by 0x4D3EB0 (0x4D4051), reached from observer slot 72 when a foreign unit with units aboard (+0x2EC > 0) is announced - an enemy convoy of troops prompts a naval pass.
struct_fields.evidence: memscan over 0x880000-0x8EA000: 0x8D4051 (1), 0x8D08E8 (0), the read 0x8B0C9F; slot 72 (0x8D5670) calls 0x8D3EB0 when the unit's owner is not the agent's and +0x2EC > 0. Wrong if 0x8D4051's register were not the agent.
struct_fields.revises: Adds its one setter, through observer slot 72.

struct_fields.name: replan_subordinates
struct_fields.comment: A request for one slot 78 pass: slot 73 calls slot 78 when it is set, at hour (id+9)%24, or on the full pass; slot 78 clears it as its last act (0x4B328C). Seeded 1. Setters: CAIUnit::SetPlanStance (0x4C3871); CEU3AI_DistributeFleetsToTheatres and CEU3AI_GatherTransportsForTheatres on both agents of a unit they move; CEU3AI::CreateUnitOrder on every agent for an invasion order (0x49AD38); CUnit_AttachToParent and CUnit_LeaveParent on the nearest agent above the unit (0x5B99F6, 0x5B9A7E).
struct_fields.evidence: memscan of byte writes of 1 at +0x86: AI range 0x88F814, 0x88F839, 0x88FB23, 0x88FB3E, 0x890286, 0x890291, 0x890B6C, 0x890B89, 0x89125F, 0x89126D, 0x89AD38, 0x8C3871; the rest of .text 0x5B99F6 and 0x5B9A7E only. Wrong if the 0x890286-0x890B89 group lay in a function other than 0x48FBB0 (functionStart could not settle it).
struct_fields.revises: Said nothing sets it in slots 78 or 79; now lists its setters, and the tick's three triggers.

struct_fields.name: area_dirty
struct_fields.comment: Makes the next tick call SetArea(this, GetArea()) at once rather than at hour 1 of a dayOfYear divisible by 7. Zero at construction. Set by CEU3AI::EnsureAgentForArea on a new agent and on the agent already covering a theatre (flag 0), by CEU3AI_MarkAgentsNearTheatres on a friend's agents near our theatres, and by CAIStrategy::MaintainTheatres (0x4AC624) on the agent of a unit it makes a theatre's headquarters. Cleared by CAIUnit::SetArea (0x4BA5C7) as its first act, whatever its guards then decide.
struct_fields.evidence: memscan of byte writes of 1 at +0x87 over all of .text: 0x88A9B5, 0x88A9F6, 0x88C118, 0x8AC624 only; the clear at 0x8BA5C7 precedes SetArea's unit/area/level guards. Wrong if a non-byte store set it.
struct_fields.revises: Adds the three other setters and that SetArea clears it before its guards.

struct_fields.name: threatened_provinces_first
struct_fields.comment: Head of a CList of CMapProvince* (tail +0x1E0, count +0x1E4, no-unlink byte +0x1E8): provinces of ours an enemy force at sea is heading for. Kept by CAIUnit_UpdateThreatenedProvinces every hour, appended by CAIUnit_AddThreatenedProvince; read by 0x4B4200, 0x4CB064/0x4CB436 and the tick's slot 80 gate (+0x1E4). Freed by the destructor.
struct_fields.evidence: memscan of +0x1DC/+0x1E0/+0x1E4 over 0x880000-0x8EA000: the constructor's zeroing (0x8AF748-0x8AF754), the destructor's free (0x8AFFCF-0x8AFFFE), 0x8B1820's walks and stores, 0x8D56A0's append, the tick's read at 0x8B0A5D. CUnit +0x1E0/+0x1E4 hits in the same range are a different object (trap 12). Wrong if 0x5C9CB7 appended something other than a province.

struct_fields.name: threatened_provinces_last
struct_fields.comment: Tail of the threatened-provinces CList at +0x1DC.
struct_fields.evidence: 0x8B1CCA-0x8B1CD9, 0x8D56EE.

struct_fields.name: threatened_provinces_count
struct_fields.comment: Count of the threatened-provinces CList at +0x1DC. Slot 73 runs slot 80 every hour while it is above 0 (0x4B0A5D).
struct_fields.evidence: 0x8B1B1D (decrement), 0x8B1CC0 and 0x8D56F4 (increment), 0x8B0A5D (the tick's test).

struct_fields.name: subunit_tally_first
struct_fields.comment: Begin of a std::vector<int> (end +0x240, capacity end +0x244) the constructor sizes to the number of sub-unit types, one per type index. ProcessAI zeroes every element at hour (id+16)%24 (0x489B4D) just before CEU3AI_DistributeFleetsToTheatres and CEU3AI_DistributeAirToTheatres, and the second reads and adds to it (0x48F8A4-0x48F976). What it counts was not read. Not CUnit +0x23C (the plan's objective count), which shares the displacement in this code.

struct_fields.name: ai_agent
struct_fields.comment: **The agent that commands this unit directly**, or null: a CAIUnit (written by CAIUnit::SetUnit at 0x4B9F04) or a CAIInvasion (CAIInvasion::AddUnit at 0x4A16D7), each only while the agent's +0x3D and +0x3E are clear - check slot 65/66 before treating it as a CAIUnit. For a country the AI runs the CAIUnit agents are one per theatre and bound to its headquarters, so **a unit below a theatre HQ has none of its own**: code finds its agent by climbing CUnit +0x1E0 to the first unit that has one. Cleared by: CAIAgent's destructor (0x49C7C0) on every unit of the country pointing at the dying agent; CUnit_AttachToParent and CUnit_LeaveParent, which remove the unit's own agent; CUnit_SetOwner, which zeroes it without telling the agent; CAIInvasion's slot 64. CAIUnit::ClearUnit does not clear it.
struct_fields.evidence: memscan of dword writes at +0x198 over .text: 0x5B99CF and 0x5B9B24 (after 0x899F70), 0x5BC481 (CUnit_SetOwner), 0x89C81D (CAIAgent destructor), 0x89CA85 (the folded steal), 0x8A16D7, 0x8A1789, 0x8A18CA (CAIInvasion), 0x8B9F04 (SetUnit); the agent creators (four, all in CEU3AI) make one agent per theatre or per planned top unit. Wrong if some other agent creator were found - findRefs gives the CAIUnit constructor exactly four callers.
struct_fields.revises: Comment rewritten: one agent per theatre, so subordinates hold null and are found by climbing; lists every writer, and that ClearUnit leaves it.

struct_fields.name: area_theatres_first
struct_fields.comment: **The same list as CAIStrategy +0xE4** (the strategy is held by value at +0x48C): the country's theatres, saved as `area_theatre` blocks and loaded by CAIStrategy::LoadKey (token 0x6EF), built by CAIStrategy::BuildTheatres, and appended to by CCreateHigherCommand::Execute (0x5DFE20) and CAddTheatreCommand::Execute, unlinked by CRemoveTheatreCommand::Execute. Read here by CEU3AI::CreateAgentsForTheatres, ProcessAI's readiness gate, CEU3AI_MarkAgentsNearTheatres, CAIUnit::SetArea, slot 76 and the interface.
struct_fields.evidence: CCountry::GetStrategy (rva 0x17BE0) is `lea eax,[ecx+0x48C]; ret`, and CAIStrategy's area_theatre list is +0xE4/+0xE8/+0xEC (its LoadKey appends there at 0x8A46CD-0x8A4725; its SaveContents reads +0xE4 at 0x8A4D43); 0x48C + 0xE4 = 0x570. The decompiler already shows the read at 0x88AAAC as `Strategy.Theatres.first`. Wrong if CCountry held a second CAIStrategy at a different offset ending here - its other two are at +0x1DC and +0x334.
struct_fields.revises: Was oob_theatres_first, 'a different set from CAIStrategy +0xE4, neither saved nor loaded' (FINDINGS-aitheatre.md section 2): it is that list, by address arithmetic, so it is saved and loaded.
